hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Seating nipple and hold-down
function: The profile in the tubing that the pump seats in and the hold-down (cups or a mechanical lock) that keeps it there against the pumping load.

tabs.overview: Top or bottom hold-down per the pump designation; the nipple is run with the tubing.
tabs.safety: The pump is unseated by picking up the rods before pulling.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
